name: Mizukano! ~Mizugi no Kanojo to H Shiyo~
original_name: みずカノ！ ～水着の彼女とHしよっ～
source:
In the future, the ice in the South Pole had melted, causing the global sea levels to rise. The popularity of swimsuits had exploded as people got accustomed to a life next to the sea. One of the top-selling swimsuit makers bought one of the new islands Takaojima and built a research school there. At this dormitory school, those who help out with creating new swimsuits do not have to pay a portion of their tuition.

Kaito returned to Takaojima, where he had once lived on when he was a child, on a personal request from his father to help collect impressions from girls trying out a new series of swimsuits planned for a competitive show. The results would be used to help develop better swimsuits. His father lent him a cat-shaped robot called Noritama, which is connected to the company internal network and has the special ability of breaking down swimsuits to the particle level and reforming them into new ones. Will he be able to create the best swimsuit ever with the girls’ help?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/07/19/july-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在未来，南极的冰层已经融化，导致全球海平面上升。人们逐渐习惯了临海生活，泳装也因此大受欢迎。一家畅销泳装制造商买下了新出现的岛屿之一高尾岛，并在那里建起一所研究学校。在这所寄宿学校里，参与设计新泳装的学生可以免除部分学费。

在父亲的私人请求下，海斗回到了自己童年曾居住过的高尾岛，协助收集女孩们试穿一系列为竞技表演准备的新泳装时的感想。这些结果将用于开发更好的泳装。父亲还借给他一台名叫诺里玉的猫形机器人。它连接着公司的内部网络，并拥有将泳装分解到粒子级别、再重组成新泳装的特殊能力。在女孩们的帮助下，他能否制作出有史以来最棒的泳装？
